chk_problem.label: accurate
chk_problem.poster_evidence: Periodic Bloom filter transmission can impose high overhead in communication-constrained distributed systems. Lossless compression preserves membership but yields only one size. OR folding creates smaller, queryable views with higher FPR while preserving no-false-negative property.
chk_problem.reason: The poster accurately describes the research problem of overhead and stale receiver states in communication-constrained systems, aligning with the reference.

chk_method.poster_evidence: Sender retains canonical Bloom filter and generates catalog of OR-folded views at various retained-length ratios (e.g., 0.95m, 0.90m, 0.75m). chk_method.reason: The poster correctly describes the method as an online policy for selecting OR-folded Bloom filters based on time-varying communication conditions.
